title: Bounded modification genus ascends through separable finite extensions
statement: Let $R\hookrightarrow S$ be a finite injective local homomorphism of commutative normal Nagata local domains of Krull dimension $2$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Assume that the induced extension $\operatorname{Frac}(S)/\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], where $\operatorname{Frac}$ denotes the field of fractions of a domain. If reduction to rational singularities is possible for $R$, then it is possible for $S$ [def-per-rational-surface-singularity].
